name: Publish work as a private link
description: Takes output your bot has already produced — a plan, a write-up, a summary — and hosts it as a web page at a URL nobody can guess, ready to share. Recipients need no login, which also means access rests entirely on the link staying private.

official.title: Publish work as a private link by Steve
